gaps: Division leaders named only in local business journals, HBA/BIA boards or conference speaker lists: not checked. This file rests on the full run of Toll Brothers' own releases (884 posts, 2023 to 2026-11-18), the 2026 investor-relations releases, the FY2025 annual report and four HBA board pages.

Division- and region-level land leaders (VP / Director of Land Acquisition, Land Development, Entitlement): not named in any company release; only the two Buffington Homes founders are sourced. Needs a follow-up search pass.

Regional presidents for the North, Mid-Atlantic and Texas / South regions: not named in 2025-2026 company releases. Older names (Eric Anderson, Regional President in Virginia, 2023; David Kelly, Group President in North Carolina, 2023; Gary Mayo, Group President in Nevada and Southern Utah, 2023) are more than 24 months old and were left out.
Successors to Karl Mistry (East) and Seth Ring (West) as Executive Vice Presidents over the regions: not disclosed in the 2026 CEO and COO announcements.
Seattle / Puget Sound: no division or group president named since Kelley Moldstad was last quoted in Aug 2025; Regional President Todd Callahan is quoted directly.
Phoenix / Arizona: only Group President Bob Flaherty is named; division presidents under him not public in releases.
Jacksonville / North Florida: only Group President Greg Netro is named.
South Carolina (Charleston, Greenville, Myrtle Beach) and coastal North Carolina: only Group President Jason Simpson is named.
Southern California sub-markets (Orange County, San Diego, Inland Empire, Coachella Valley): only Brad Hare is named.
Michigan: current division president unclear (Isaac Boyd through Sept 2025; John Dean quoted in Jan-Feb 2026).
Delaware: no 2025-2026 release; John Dean was styled Division President in Pennsylvania and Delaware in 2023-24.
Maryland: covered by the D.C. Metro division (Nimita Shah); no separate Maryland leader named.
Colorado Springs: no division president named since April 2025.
Illinois: no longer listed among the company's regions in the FY2025 annual report (last Illinois release was a final-opportunity notice in Jan 2024).
Toll Brothers Apartment Living and Campus Living presidents: not covered in this pass.
Reporting lines are not published by the company; every reports_to here is Inferred from titles and from who was quoted before a new division president appeared.
Division office phones and emails: not published per person; left blank.
